# Joshua Udom — Visual Designer

Joshua Udom is a visual designer with 2+ years of experience creating
functional designs that drive action. His work spans event branding, social
media content, church media, and full brand identities.

## Skills

- Figma
- CorelDraw
- Adobe Photoshop
- Adobe Illustrator
- Brand identity design
- Event branding
- Social media graphics
- Flyer and poster design

## Experience

- 2+ years creating functional designs for businesses and organizations
- 15+ projects completed across branding, social content, and campaigns
